45/S0.subgoal: Explain what empirical evaluation is and its role in the system development lifecycle.

45/S1.subgoal: Contrast prototype evaluation with empirical study and identify the requirements for performing a usability study.

45/S2.subgoal: Describe the four stages of the empirical research process, including framing research questions and identifying variables.

45/S3.subgoal: Summarize the key points of the empirical evaluation process and its stages.
